lastResponse.text: First step: because you’re getting shaky and your insulin is missing, call nine one one now. This can turn urgent fast, and they can get you immediate medical help today. If the call drops, dial nine one one again right away.
originalTexts: First step: because you’re getting shaky and your insulin is missing, call 911 now. This can turn urgent fast, and they can get you immediate medical help today. If the call drops, dial 911 again right away.
slottedCanonicalQueryTemplates: I’m not like passing out right now, but I’m starting to feel shaky and I need somewhere today, not next week.
